10 pilot gift ideas to look for with a $25 budget

A $25 budget works best when the gift is small, personal, and easy to deliver. This is an idea list, not a claim that every version currently sells below $25. Compare the complete delivered price before choosing, and skip customizations that consume the budget without making the gift more meaningful.

By Pilot Gift Guide · From the team behind ATC · How we choose

IN THIS GUIDEHow to chooseThe listRelated guides

How to choose

Set aside room for tax and shipping first. Local pickup, existing photographs, and simple packaging can help keep the total manageable. Choose one useful item or a specific memory instead of several low-quality objects bundled under an aviation theme.

The list

Our selections prioritize personal relevance, usefulness, and fit for the recipient. Named products and destinations link to official sources where applicable.

  1. 1

    Aircraft postcard and note

    Choose a design connected to a favorite plane or airport. The handwritten message should explain the connection rather than simply repeat a greeting.

  2. 2

    Small aviation notebook

    Look for a readable, practical format with understated artwork. Check page size and binding before paying extra for an aircraft on the cover.

  3. 3

    Printed personal flight photo

    Use a photograph you may print and a modest frame. Local printing can help you compare the total before committing.

  4. 4

    Airplane bookmark

    A slim bookmark suits a reader and travels easily. Avoid elaborate shapes that could damage pages or make the book difficult to close.

  5. 5

    Simple luggage tag

    Choose a distinctive but practical tag. Leave contact information to the recipient and compare shipping charges on inexpensive items.

  6. 6

    Used aviation book

    Look for a subject they enjoy and an honest condition description. A clean reading copy can make a better gift than an unsuitable new title.

  7. 7

    Small aircraft ornament

    Pick an aircraft or style the recipient likes. Verify dimensions, materials, and seasonal relevance before choosing a novelty decoration.

  8. 8

    Everyday pen

    A reliable pen with a personal note can be enough. Avoid letting engraving push a modest gift beyond the intended total.

  9. 9

    Airport coffee outing

    Treat them to time together at a convenient location. Confirm access and prices if you are considering an airport-adjacent venue.

  10. 10

    Homemade aviation activity kit

    Combine paper, original activity prompts, and a small folder. Use supplies already available where possible and tailor the difficulty to the recipient.

These are editorial recommendations and planning ideas, not hands-on test results. Read our selection approach and ATC disclosure.
